title: AI Website Development Intern
description:
**AI Website Development Intern**

Company: Teknoppy PVt Ltd  
Location: Kochi, Kerala  
Job Type: Paid Internship  
Duration: 3 Months  
Experience: Freshers Welcome  
Work Mode: On-site

**About Teknoppy**

Teknoppy is a digital solutions company specialising in website development, SEO, digital marketing and AI-powered business solutions.

We are looking for an enthusiastic AI Website Development Intern who is interested in creating modern websites using AI-powered development tools.

The selected candidate will work under the guidance of our Website Development Team Leader and contribute to developing websites for real client projects.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Create websites using AI-powered website development tools.
* Write effective prompts and instructions to generate website layouts and pages.
* Convert Figma designs, screenshots and reference websites into functional websites using AI.
* Use AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude and other AI coding assistants.
* Refine website layouts, colours, typography and visual elements using AI prompts.
* Make websites responsive across desktop, tablet and mobile devices.
* Use AI tools to identify and resolve website design and functionality issues.
* Assist with website content placement and basic SEO implementation.
* Review generated websites and ensure they meet project requirements.
* Coordinate with the Website Development Team Leader for project updates and revisions.

**Skills Required**

* Basic computer and internet knowledge.
* Interest in AI tools and emerging technologies.
* Good logical thinking and problem-solving abilities.
* Creative thinking and an eye for website design.
* Ability to understand website layouts and visual references.
* Good communication and instruction-following skills.
* Willingness to learn new AI tools and workflows.

**Preferred Skills**

* Familiarity with ChatGPT or Claude.
* Basic knowledge of website design.
* Familiarity with Figma or Canva.
* Previous experience experimenting with AI tools.
* Basic understanding of websites and responsive design.

No advanced programming or manual coding experience is required.

**What You Will Learn**

* AI-assisted website development workflows.
* Prompt engineering for website creation.
* Creating websites using the Astro framework through AI tools.
* Converting design references into functional websites.
* Website layout and responsive design principles.
* AI-assisted website testing and optimisation.
* Basic website SEO and performance optimisation.
* Managing website projects and deployment.

**Internship Details**

* Duration: 3 Months
* Job Type: Paid Internship
* Location: Kochi, Kerala
* Monthly Stipend: ₹8000

\*

* Work Mode: On-site
* Reporting To: Website Development Team Leader
* Laptop: Candidates must have their own laptop.

**Career Opportunity**

Candidates demonstrating good performance, creativity, prompt-writing skills and the ability to deliver quality websites may be considered for a full-time position at Teknoppy.

**Who Can Apply?**

* Freshers and final-year students.
* Students from any academic background with an interest in AI.
* Candidates interested in website creation and AI-powered tools.
* Individuals who enjoy experimenting with new technologies.

Candidates do not need prior experience in Astro JS or programming. Training and project guidance will be provided by the Team Leader.

Pay: ₹8,000.00 - ₹15,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Sr React Team Lead
description:
We are seeking a highly skilled **Senior React Developer to develop and enhance the user interface of our Core Banking & Financial Service Solution (CBFSS)** and other enterprise applications. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in React.js, Bootstrap, and frontend architecture, ensuring a seamless and high-performance user experience.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Design and develop responsive, scalable, and high-performance UI using React.js, Bootstrap, and related technologies.

* Build reusable UI components, ensuring modularity and maintainability.

* Implement efficient state management using Redux, Context API, or other relevant libraries.

* Optimize frontend performance, including lazy loading, caching, and efficient rendering.

* Work closely with backend developers to integrate RESTful APIs and ensure smooth data flow.

* Ensure applications work seamlessly across different browsers and devices.

* Follow clean coding standards, conduct peer code reviews, and enforce best practices.

* Work closely with UX/UI designers, backend developers, and product teams to create a seamless user experience.

* Write unit tests and perform debugging to ensure robust application performance.

* Maintain clear documentation for UI components, workflows, and technical decisions.

**Required Skills & Experience:**

* 5+ years of experience in frontend development with a strong focus on React.js and Bootstrap.

* Expertise in JavaScript (ES6+), TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3, and SCSS.

* Hands-on experience with Redux, Context API, or other state management solutions.

* Proficiency in RESTful API integration and handling asynchronous operations (Axios, Fetch, etc.).

* Strong understanding of responsive design, mobile-first development, and cross-browser compatibility.

* Knowledge of frontend performance optimization techniques.

* Familiarity with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and agile development practices.

* Experience with unit testing frameworks (Jest, React Testing Library, or Cypress) is a plus.

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: Up to ₹2,500,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Paid sick time
* Provident Fund

Application Question(s):

* are u willing to relocate to kochi?

Language:

* Malayalam (Required)

Work Location: In person

title: Front End Developer
description:
* ​**Cross-Platform Mobile Development:** Design, build, and maintain robust, feature-rich mobile applications using **React Native** for both iOS and Android.
* ​**Web Application Architecture:** Develop and scale server-rendered and static web applications using **Next.js (App Router / Pages Router)**, React, and TypeScript.
* ​**API Integration & Backend Collaboration:** Architect and consume robust RESTful APIs, GraphQL endpoints, and backend services (Node.js, Firebase, PostgreSQL, etc.) to power web and mobile platforms.
* ​**Performance & Optimization:** Optimize mobile app memory, frame rates (60fps), and network payloads, while ensuring top-tier Next.js web performance, Core Web Vitals, and SEO rankings.
* ​**State & Data Management:** Implement scalable state management patterns across web and mobile using tools like Redux Toolkit, Zustand, or React Context.
* ​**CI/CD & Deployment:** Manage application builds, automated testing pipelines, and deployment processes for Apple App Store Connect, Google Play Console, and web hosting platforms (Vercel, AWS, etc.).
* ​**Code Quality & Leadership:** Conduct rigorous code reviews, establish engineering best practices, write automated tests (Jest, Detox/Cypress), and mentor junior team members.

​**Required Qualifications & Skills**

* ​**Experience:** 3 to 5 years of professional software engineering experience, with a strong, demonstrable portfolio of production-ready web and mobile applications.

Pay: Up to ₹30,000.00 per month

Ability to commute/relocate:

* Maradu, Kochi, Kerala: Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Preferred)

Experience:

* Next.js: 1 year (Required)

Location:

* Maradu, Kochi, Kerala (Required)

title: React JS & Frontend Application Development Intern
description:
### **Build Modern Web Interfaces | Develop Responsive Applications | Gain Real-World Experience**

### **Job Description**

Wahy Lab Solutions is looking for creative, motivated, and detail-oriented candidates for the position of React JS & Frontend Application Development Intern. The role involves building responsive, interactive, and user-friendly web applications using React JS and modern frontend technologies. Interns will gain practical exposure to component-based architecture, API integration, state management, and frontend performance optimisation through industry-oriented projects.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and maintain responsive, interactive user interfaces using React JS.
* Build reusable components and modular frontend application features.
* Convert UI/UX designs and wireframes into functional web interfaces.
* Implement React Hooks, component lifecycle concepts, and state management.
* Integrate REST APIs and handle dynamic application data.
* Apply JavaScript ES6+ features and modern frontend development practices.
* Create responsive layouts compatible with different devices and browsers.
* Perform debugging, testing, and frontend performance optimisation.
* Collaborate with UI/UX designers, backend developers, and project teams.
* Use Git and GitHub for version control and collaborative development.
* Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, and project planning.
* Maintain technical documentation and contribute to live web development projects.

### **Required Skills**

* Basic knowledge of JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS3.
* Understanding of React JS fundamentals and component-based architecture.
* Familiarity with JSX, React Hooks, props, and state management.
* Basic knowledge of JavaScript ES6+ concepts.
* Understanding of REST API integration and JSON data handling.
* Familiarity with responsive web design and CSS frameworks is an advantage.
* Basic knowledge of Git and GitHub is preferred.
* Awareness of TypeScript, Redux, or Context API is an added advantage.
* Strong logical reasoning, analytical thinking, and problem-solving skills.
* Good communication, teamwork, and willingness to learn.

### **Qualification**

* Any Degree / Diploma / PG / ITI.
* Freshers are welcome to apply.
* Candidates interested in frontend development, React JS, and modern web technologies are encouraged to apply.

### **Job Details**

* Job Title: React JS & Frontend Application Development Intern
* Job Type: Full-Time / Part-Time
* Work Mode: Work from Office (WFO) / Work from Home (WFH) / Hybrid
* Location: Kakkanad, Kochi, Kerala

### **Career Opportunities**

This internship can help candidates prepare for future roles such as:

* React JS Developer
* Frontend Developer
* UI Developer
* JavaScript Developer
* Web Application Developer
* Junior Frontend Engineer

### **Why Join Us?**

* Modern UI Workflows: Gain hands-on exposure to modular React component architectures, custom hooks, and dynamic state management.
* Real-World API Consumption: Learn how to wire complex backend REST services and JSON feeds into seamless user interfaces.
* Design-to-Code Mastery: Practice translating UI/UX wireframes and Figma designs into clean, responsive HTML/CSS/React layouts across all device form factors.
* Portfolio Development: Build a rich, production-grade frontend project portfolio using modern JavaScript ES6+ standards and Git collaboration toolchains.

### **Apply Now and Start Building Your Career in Frontend Development!**

Interested candidates may apply by mailing their resume to hr@wahylab.com

* Develop responsive and user-friendly web interfaces using React.js and Next.js.
* Build reusable UI components using HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, and TypeScript.

* Work with Next.js routing, layouts, and Server and Client Components.

* Use Tailwind CSS or other modern styling techniques to build consistent interfaces.

* Opportunity to work on real-world software development projects.
* Practical exposure to modern frontend technologies and development workflows.
* Guidance and opportunities to develop technical skills.
* A collaborative working environment with scope for professional growth.

How to Apply

Interested candidates can submit their updated resume along with links to their GitHub profile, portfolio, or relevant projects, if available.
